_note: Song unlock dialog layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255. theme is handed to PopUI as is, so its keys keep PopUI's names.

title._note: The song title: y is its centre from the panel's top; it fits the panel's width less margin_x on each side.

purse._note: y is the purse's top from the panel's top (its price sits 26 px above it).

buttons._note: bottom is the buttons' top, from the panel's bottom; gap is between Buy and Cancel.
